purpose: Database-backed features that parallel agents build and test on isolated Git and Neon branches.

instructions: Create one worktree and matching Neon branch for each task.
Confirm that the worktree has its own .neon and .env.local files before changing the database.
Start one agent in each worktree and give it only its assigned task object.
Change the Drizzle schema and generate a migration for every database change.
Apply migrations only from the assigned feature worktree. Never apply a feature migration from the main worktree.
Create test data with the task's unique isolationMarker on the feature's Neon branch.
After all agents finish, query each Neon branch and confirm that its isolationMarker is absent from main and the other feature branches.
Run every verification command before committing.
Commit each task on its own feature branch.

Schema and Drizzle migration metadata can conflict during integration. Merge features one at a time, resolve the final schema, and generate a clean integration migration on a separate Neon branch before updating main.

tasks.title: Add task priorities
tasks.objective: Let users assign a low, medium, or high priority to each task and test the schema change on an isolated Neon branch.
databaseChanges: Add a non-null priority column to tasks.
Use low, medium, and high as the only valid values.
Use medium as the default so existing rows remain valid.
Add a database check constraint for the allowed values.
requirements: Create a Drizzle migration and apply it to this feature's Neon branch.
Create app/priorities/page.tsx to list tasks ordered by priority.
Add a server action under app/priorities that changes a task's priority.
Create a high-priority task whose title is exactly isolation:task-priority.
Verify through Drizzle that the new priority value is stored.
Do not change the root task board page.

tasks.title: Add task comments
tasks.objective: Let agents leave comments on tasks using a new table that exists only on this feature's Neon branch during development.
databaseChanges: Add a task_comments table with id, task_id, author_name, body, and created_at columns.
Add a foreign key from task_comments.task_id to tasks.id.
Delete comments automatically when their task is deleted.
Require a non-empty comment body with a maximum length of 1000 characters.
requirements: Create a Drizzle migration and apply it to this feature's Neon branch.
Create app/comments/page.tsx to select a task, view its comments, and add a comment.
Use Drizzle for all reads and writes.
Add a comment whose body is exactly isolation:task-comments.
Verify that the comment can be read back with its task title.
Do not change the root task board page.

tasks.title: Add task labels
tasks.objective: Let users organize tasks with reusable labels while the new relational schema is isolated from other feature work.
databaseChanges: Add a labels table with id, name, color, and created_at columns.
Add a task_labels join table with task_id and label_id foreign keys.
Use a composite primary key to prevent duplicate labels on a task.
Delete join rows automatically when a task or label is deleted.
requirements: Create a Drizzle migration and apply it to this feature's Neon branch.
Create app/labels/page.tsx to create labels and assign them to tasks.
Use Drizzle for all reads and writes.
Create a label whose name is exactly isolation:task-labels and assign it to a task.
Verify that a Drizzle join query returns the task and its label.
Do not change the root task board page.

tasks.title: Add subtasks
tasks.objective: Let users break a task into smaller checklist items using a new table on an isolated Neon branch.
databaseChanges: Add a subtasks table with id, task_id, title, completed, position, created_at, and updated_at columns.
Add a foreign key from subtasks.task_id to tasks.id.
Delete subtasks automatically when their task is deleted.
Default completed to false and position to zero.
Require a non-empty title with a maximum length of 120 characters.
requirements: Create a Drizzle migration and apply it to this feature's Neon branch.
Create app/subtasks/page.tsx to add, complete, and delete subtasks for a selected task.
Order subtasks by position and creation time.
Use Drizzle for all reads and writes.
Create and complete a subtask whose title is exactly isolation:task-subtasks.
Verify through Drizzle that its completed value changed to true.
Do not change the root task board page.
